sections.bio: I'm a Senior Full-Stack Engineer focused on building scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms, AI-powered products, and high-performance web and mobile applications. I enjoy taking products from idea to production, combining frontend architecture, backend engineering, system design, and AI-assisted development.My core expertise spans React.js, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase, AWS, Docker, and CI/CD. I've also built and integrated AI/LLM and voice-agent workflows, payment systems, authentication, real-time communication, and third-party APIs.At Obenan, I joined as a Frontend Developer and progressed to Frontend Lead, now leading both frontend and full-stack projects across the Dashboard, Landing Platform, and Omnipulse. I own architecture and technical decisions, deliver scalable multi-tenant features, backend services, AI integrations, and performance optimizations, while mentoring engineers and driving production delivery.Previously, I built and shipped production React Native applications for iOS and Android across healthcare, real estate, e-commerce, and enterprise domains, including advanced native integrations and real-time features.I'm naturally curious and enjoy turning challenging problems into simple, reliable solutions. I enjoy learning new technologies, experimenting with ideas, and building products that solve real business problems. I also use modern AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.Open to remote, hybrid, and international opportunities. If you're looking for an engineer who can take ownership from architecture and backend systems to polished user experiences and production delivery, I'd be happy to connect.Best way to reach me: [email protected]: https://muhammadafzal.vercel.app
